title: 1. The CIA Triad
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L06: Security Principles & Mindset: 1. The CIA Triad .

items: Availability — ensures timely access for authorized users (DDoS, hardware failure)
Foundational model that applies to all assets, not just data
One control may map to multiple components (e.g., RAID = availability)

blocks.text: Every security decision can be classified by which CIA component it primarily protects. Asking "Which leg of CIA does this serve?" is the fastest way to verify a control is actually doing security work.
Shon Harris occasionally uses "AIC" — same concept, different ordering. The exam uses CIA.

items: Helps classify which CIA component a given threat targets
